subject: Fix compile on macOS 13 (#12611)
reason: Build-only fix: the diff changes macOS version-detection preprocessor macros in src/config.h and src/debug.c, all guarded by #if defined(__APPLE__). On the Linux hosts the fuzzer runs on, the preprocessor output and compiled binary are identical to the parent, so no runtime path differs; the change exists solely to make the source compile on macOS 13. No scenario can exercise it.
